title: Microphone adjustment and chautauqua chatter
summary: Equipment is adjusted and Holley and Billie Henderson chat about chautauquas.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Okay. Growing up. Excuse me … (someone comes in and adjusts the mikes and recording equipment. chatter....) Billie Henderson:: I wonder about chautauqua. I made a note. What is it … chautauqua? I never heard of that.
(?) My mother's talked about that. My mother's from Oklahoma.
My grandmother was from Oklahoma, she talked about that.

Yeah. Yeah. Listen, just so far as this interview's concerned, this is … Billie will ask me questions … on the tape, if you know that I may ask her some questions some time or she may prompt me, if you don't mind?
